I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **#4092**.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse said in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55 that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. Dana is a member of #north-random, so she could see this herself.
- **Status unknown:** #help-it-ops has no messages, so I couldn't confirm whether the ticket is still open. I said so in the reply.
